property_summary: For any admissible caller, calling airDrop any positive number of times leaves that caller's tokenBalance at exactly 20 (the airdrop is once-per-address), which the reference always satisfies but the mutant violates because a second call passes the ==20 check and doubles the balance to 40.
change_summary: Change the hasNoBalance check to require a balance of 20, so only users who already received a drop can call it.
